INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GTT_TEMP_INTO_GROUP_MEASURE ( USER_GROUP, DIVISION_ID, MEASURE, DAYS, FROM_TIME, TO_TIME, LIMIT_MEASURE ) SELECT B.USER_GROUP, B.DIVISION_ID, B.MEASURE, B.DAYS, B.FROM_TIME, B.TO_TIME, LM.TOKEN AS LIMIT_MEASURE FROM (SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS USER_GROUP, A.SEGMENT3 AS DIVISION_ID, A.SEGMENT4 AS MEASURE, DT.TOKEN AS DAYS , A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS FROM_TIME, A.ATTRIBUTE3 AS TO_TIME, A.ATTRIBUTE4 AS LIMIT_MEASURE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ATTRIBUTE1, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) AS TOKEN FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= NVL(REGEXP_COUNT(A.ATTRIBUTE1, ','), 0) + 1) DT WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND (A.SEGMENT1 = :B3 OR A.SEGMENT1 IN (SELECT G.USER_GR_ID FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G WHERE G.USER_ID IN (:B3 , :B4 ) AND G.USE_YN = 'Y')) AND A.SEGMENT2 = :B2 AND A.SEGMENT3 = :B1 ) B CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(B.LIMIT_MEASURE, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) AS TOKEN FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= NVL(REGEXP_COUNT(B.LIMIT_MEASURE, ','), 0) + 1) LM WHERE (REPLACE(B.DAYS, ' ', '') IS NULL OR B.DAYS = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH')) AND (REPLACE(B.FROM_TIME, ' ', '') IS NULL OR B.FROM_TIME <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MI')) AND (REPLACE(B.TO_TIME, ' ', '') IS NULL OR B.TO_TIME >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MI'))

END OF STMT

MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_MF_SP T
                USING ( SELECT RID_
                             , MAX(CREATE_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, TEAM_ID, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, GROUP_ID, ITEM_ID, NICK_NAME, INCOTERMS, FCST_TYPE, DOM_EXP, CURRENCY, VERSION_NO, SOLDTO_CUSTOMER, COUNTRY_NAME, CITY_NAME, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_TYPE, OWNER, VMI_YN, SENDER_NAME, PROJECT_CODE, PLANT_SITE_ID, AS_FROM_SITE, PROJECT_S_OP_REPORT, BIZ_TYPE, PROJECT_NAME, PROJECT_STATUS, PROJECT_OWNER, CELL_PER_CAR, CELL_PER_MODULE, MODULE_PER_CAR, MEASURE, MEASURE_GROUP, BUCKET, EDIT_FLAG, SORT_KEY, NEW_FLAG, ATTR1, VMI_STD_DIO, AS_YN, NOTATION, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, SORT_ORDER_NO) AS LU_DATE
                             , MAX(LAST_UPDATED_BY) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY CREATE_DATE NULLS FIRST) OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, TEAM_ID, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, GROUP_ID, ITEM_ID, NICK_NAME, INCOTERMS, FCST_TYPE, DOM_EXP, CURRENCY, VERSION_NO, SOLDTO_CUSTOMER, COUNTRY_NAME, CITY_NAME, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_TYPE, OWNER, VMI_YN, SENDER_NAME, PROJECT_CODE, PLANT_SITE_ID, AS_FROM_SITE, PROJECT_S_OP_REPORT, BIZ_TYPE, PROJECT_NAME, PROJECT_STATUS, PROJECT_OWNER, CELL_PER_CAR, CELL_PER_MODULE, MODULE_PER_CAR, MEASURE, MEASURE_GROUP, BUCKET, EDIT_FLAG, SORT_KEY, NEW_FLAG, ATTR1, VMI_STD_DIO, AS_YN, NOTATION, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, SORT_ORDER_NO) AS LU_BY
                        FROM ( SELECT MSP.ROWID AS RID_, MSP.*, MSP.DEPT_ID AS TEAM_ID, MSP.DEPT_NAME_KO AS TEAM_NAME_KO, MSP.CELL_MODEL AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
                                    , NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.SUN),'0')||NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.MON),'0')||NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.TUE),'0')||NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.WED),'0')||NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.THU),'0')||NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.FRI),'0')||NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.SAT),'0') AS BUCKET
                               FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_MF_SP MSP ) F
                        WHERE ((MEASURE NOT IN ('SCM_FCST','FCST_GAP') AND QTY <> 0) OR MEASURE IN ('SCM_FCST','FCST_GAP')) ) S
                ON (T.ROWID = S.RID_)
                WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.CREATE_DATE = S.LU_DATE, T.LAST_UPDATED_BY = S.LU_BY
                WHERE DECODE(T.CREATE_DATE, S.LU_DATE, 0, 1) = 1 OR DECODE(T.LAST_UPDATED_BY, S.LU_BY, 0, 1) = 1

END OF STMT
